question: For each of EXPLOSIVE's 15 stopped explosive starts: does it end after one merge and a finite burst, repeat, or keep growing past its burst, read from the first stage whose reduced map lies in the proved class?

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py; python3 -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: runs/explosive (the starts); DEAD-CAP deadlib (branch system); DOUBLE-IDENT machine_check (classify); joinlib engine

forbidden_inputs: Changing the reduction, the reading, a prediction or the merge threshold after reading the frozen run
primary_observable: R1-R4 of research/MERGE-BURST-20261119-001/preregistration.md and each start's verdict

predictions.R1: branch-system count equals every grown check round
predictions.R2a: every first reading is one maximal block
predictions.R2b: every start that reaches a reading closes
predictions.R3: at least 5 of 15 reach a reading
predictions.R4: where the next stage is in the reduced class, its reading agrees

stop_rule: One run; stop when each of the 15 is classified or one is shown to keep growing.
runtime: under two hours on 2 workers (15 minutes per start at most)
disclosed_exploration: the pilot on the closed start
